video.title: NeoBit 寫入：熱電洞誘發電子注入
transcript: 寫入 · 01/04 初始狀態：FG 儲存負電荷較少，p 通道未進入寫入後的導通狀態。
寫入 · 02/04 施加條件：選通 pMOS，在通道建立橫向高場；FG 經電容耦合改變電位。
寫入 · 03/04 載子移動：加速電洞產生電子／電洞對；部分熱電子穿過氧化層進入 FG。
寫入 · 04/04 保持結果：脈衝移除後保留 Q−；p 通道在指定讀取條件下較易導通。

video.title: NeoBit program: hot-hole-induced electron injection
transcript: Program · 01/04 Initial State：less stored negative FG charge; p-channel is not in its programmed conductive state.
Program · 02/04 Apply Conditions：select pMOS and establish a lateral channel field; coupling shifts FG potential.
Program · 03/04 Carrier Motion：accelerated holes create electron–hole pairs; some hot electrons enter FG through oxide.
Program · 04/04 Retained Result：Q− remains after the pulse; the p-channel conducts more readily at specified read bias.

video.title: NeoEE 完整 MTP 循環：寫入 → 讀取 → 抹除 → 讀取
transcript: 寫入 · 01/04 初始狀態：FG 處於較少電子的示意狀態。
寫入 · 02/04 施加條件：耦合及穿隧端建立所需氧化層電場。
寫入 · 03/04 載子移動：電子由 MOS 穿隧區以 FN 方式進入 FG。
寫入 · 04/04 保持結果：電場解除，FG 電荷增加並保留。
讀取 · 01/04 保持狀態：兩種 FG 電荷狀態形成不同臨界條件。
讀取 · 02/04 選擇單元：選擇器開啟讀取通道。
讀取 · 03/04 感測路徑：路徑：感測通道導電差異，不產生 FN 電荷搬移。
讀取 · 04/04 比較結果：結果：比較參考值，保持 FG 電荷。
抹除 · 01/04 寫入後狀態：FG 保留已寫入電荷。
抹除 · 02/04 切換端點條件：切換端點條件，建立移出電荷所需電場。
抹除 · 03/04 移出電子：電子由 FG 經 FN 穿隧移至 MOS 接收區。
抹除 · 04/04 可再次寫入：結果：FG 電荷減少，可再次寫入。
讀取 · 01/04 保持狀態：兩種 FG 電荷狀態形成不同臨界條件。
讀取 · 02/04 選擇單元：選擇器開啟讀取通道。
讀取 · 03/04 感測路徑：路徑：感測通道導電差異，不產生 FN 電荷搬移。
讀取 · 04/04 比較結果：結果：比較參考值，保持 FG 電荷。

video.title: NeoEE full MTP cycle: program → read → erase → read
transcript: Program · 01/04 Initial State：FG is shown with fewer electrons.
Program · 02/04 Apply Conditions：coupling and tunneling terminals establish oxide field.
Program · 03/04 Carrier Motion：electrons enter FG from a MOS tunneling region by FN tunneling.
Program · 04/04 Retained Result：field removal leaves increased FG charge.
Read · 01/04 Retained State：two FG charge states create different thresholds.
Read · 02/04 Select the Cell：selectors enable the read channel.
Read · 03/04 Sense the Path：Path: sense channel conductance without FN charge transfer.
Read · 04/04 Compare the Result：Result: compare against a reference while preserving FG charge.
Erase · 01/04 Programmed State：FG retains programmed charge.
Erase · 02/04 Switch Terminal Conditions：switch terminal conditions to establish charge-removal field.
Erase · 03/04 Remove Electrons：electrons leave FG by FN tunneling into a MOS receiving region.
Erase · 04/04 Ready to Reprogram：Result: reduced FG charge permits another program cycle.
Read · 01/04 Retained State：two FG charge states create different thresholds.
Read · 02/04 Select the Cell：selectors enable the read channel.
Read · 03/04 Sense the Path：Path: sense channel conductance without FN charge transfer.
Read · 04/04 Compare the Result：Result: compare against a reference while preserving FG charge.
